title: 자음 14개의 이름: 기역, 니은, 디귿…
objective: By the end, you can say the name of each of the 14 basic consonants (ㄱ to ㅎ) and pronounce the 받침 in each name correctly.
summary: Learn to read and say the names of the 14 basic Korean consonants, including how the 받침 in each name sounds.

task.title: Read and write the names
task.line: Use the name pattern and the 받침 rules on page 1 to answer each item.

words.exampleMeaning: milk (ㅇ is silent at the start of a syllable)

letters.letter: ㅣ + 으 + the same letter (니은, 미음, 비읍)
letters.as: Most names: the letter with ㅣ, then 으 with the letter as 받침.
Three names break the pattern. Memorize them: not 기윽, 디읃, 시읏.

letters.letter: 받침 ㅅ ㅈ ㅊ ㅌ ㅎ → [ㄷ]
letters.as: All end like the 't' in 'hot', with the tongue held, not released.
ㅋ ends like the 'k' in 'book'; ㅍ like the 'p' in 'cup'.

exercises: Write the name of each consonant: ① ㄹ ② ㅂ ③ ㅋ
Which consonant does each name stand for? ① 미음 ② 티읕 ③ 이응
Write the real sound of each name in [ ]: ① 지읒 ② 치읓 ③ 피읖
Is the name spelled correctly? Write O or X. If X, write the correct name: ① 기윽 ② 리을 ③ 시읏
Say the name of the first consonant in each word: ① 나비 ② 포도 ③ 하나
answers: ① 리을 ② 비읍 ③ 키읔
① ㅁ ② ㅌ ③ ㅇ
① X (기역) ② O ③ X (시옷)
① 니은 (ㄴ) ② 피읖 (ㅍ) ③ 히읗 (ㅎ)
